sources.snippet: However, I'm using MiniCPM-Llama3-V-2_5-int4 on my custom and extremely jank Neuro-LLM-Server to host the model. This model has amazing high resolution input, great OCR, and is based on Llama 3 so the output is very similar to the text-only mode. The int4 quantized version uses approximately 8GB of VRAM.
